name: Procurement method
description: How bids were invited, per OCDS. This is the field that makes non-competitive awards visible. Publishing it consistently is what allows anyone to ask how much of a government's spending was never competed - a question that is otherwise unanswerable no matter how many contracts are published.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Limited
hasDefinedTerm.description: A small number of suppliers are invited directly.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Direct
hasDefinedTerm.description: Awarded to one supplier without competition. Always publish procurementMethodRationale alongside this: a sole-source award without a stated reason is the most common audit finding in public procurement.
